exec patrolbot config 
cmp stdout help.golden

exec patrolbot config --help
cmp stdout help.golden

exec patrolbot config -
cmp stdout help.golden

-- help.golden --

  Manage PatrolBot configuration.                                                                                       
  Configuration sources (from highest to lowest priority):                                                              
                                                                                                                        
    1. Command-line flags                                                                                               
       Example: --wiki wikipedia                                                                                        
                                                                                                                        
    2. Environment variables                                                                                            
       Example: PATROLBOT_WIKI=wikipedia                                                                                
                                                                                                                        
    3. Configuration file (YAML)                                                                                        
       Only one file is loaded, chosen from:                                                                            
         a. Path specified by --config                                                                                  
         b. ./config.yaml                                                                                               
         c. $HOME/.patrolbot/config.yaml                                                                                
         
  USAGE  
         
    patrolbot config [command] [--flags]  
            
  COMMANDS  
            
    init            Initialize PatrolBot configuration file
    view [--flags]  View merged configuration
         
  FLAGS  
         
    -h --help       Help for config
